panels.description: Whether Gemini spend is estimated or unsupported on API response events.

panels.description: Most frequently used tools in Gemini CLI tool call events.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"${service:regex}"} event_name:="gemini_cli.tool_call" tool_name:* | stats by (tool_name) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 10

panels.title: Gemini Top Tools

panels.description: Estimated cost by Gemini model over time.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"${service:regex}"} event_name:="gemini_cli.api_response" cost_source:="estimated" effective_cost_usd:* model:* | stats by (model) sum(effective_cost_usd) c | math max(c,0) * ${eur_rate} as cost_eur | fields model, cost_eur

panels.title: Gemini Cost by Model
